description: Experience seamless charging on the go with this 10,000mAh Mini Power Bank, designed for ultimate portability and convenience. With 20W PD & QC fast charging, power up your devices in no time, while the 15W wireless charging ensures hassle-free, cable-free convenience for Qi-compatible smartphones. The MagSafe-compatible design with a strong magnetic grip makes it perfect for iPhones, while the built-in mobile stand allows hands-free video calls and media viewing. Equipped with a bi-directional Type-C port, this power bank supports both fast input and output charging, letting you power up multiple devices efficiently. The smart LED battery indicator keeps you informed of charge levels, and the detachable Type-C cable ensures a seamless experience. Designed with multi-layer safety protection, it safeguards against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits, offering a safe and reliable power solution. Its ultra-compact, lightweight build makes it ideal for travel, daily commutes, or emergency charging, keeping your devices powered anytime, anywhere!
